source_records.notes: No single day >=30% of total PnL; eval only; exceed is not a fail.

source_records.notes: P&L incl open/unrealized+closed+commissions; 5pm-5pm CT; hitting limit = fail even open.

source_records.title: Help: Trailing drawdown

source_records.title: Help: After passing evaluation

source_records.title: Help: Commissions
source_records.notes: Live commissions; micros $0.82-$1.20/side; Rithmic table.

source_records.title: Help: Reset pricing
source_records.notes: Dynamic $25K-$50K; fixed $100K-$200K; reset < new subscription.

source_records.title: Help: How to reset
source_records.notes: Dashboard reset button; no billing restart.

source_records.title: Help: Data fees
source_records.notes: Non-pro covered; pro $140/$156; DOM extra.

source_records.title: Help: Overnight positions
source_records.notes: Cannot hold overnight; flat by 3:50pm CT.

source_records.title: Help: Copy trades policy
source_records.notes: Trade copiers forbidden on all programs; no refund if used.

source_records.title: Help: Multiple accounts

source_records.title: Help: Age requirement

source_records.notes: All CME/CBOT/NYMEX/COMEX futures incl micros; no forex/BTC/Ether.
